parrafo.es: 927 Events es un edificio histórico de dos plantas en pleno downtown de Jacksonville, con ladrillo a la vista y ventanas tipo loft. Bodas, eventos corporativos y celebraciones privadas, todos en el mismo espacio.
parrafo.en: 927 Events is a historic two-story building in the heart of downtown Jacksonville, with exposed brick and loft-style windows. Weddings, corporate events and private celebrations, all in the same space.

parrafo_1.es: 927 Events es un edificio histórico de dos plantas en el downtown de Jacksonville, convertido en espacio para eventos. Ladrillo a la vista, pisos de madera y ventanas tipo loft le dan un caracter que no se consigue en un salón de hotel.
parrafo_1.en: 927 Events is a historic two-story building in downtown Jacksonville, turned into an event space. Exposed brick, wood floors and loft-style windows give it a character you will not find in another hotel ballroom.

parrafo_2.es: Por aquí han pasado bodas, recepciones, reuniones de empresa y hasta clases privadas: el espacio se adapta al tipo de evento que traigas, y los invitados que han estado aquí lo cuentan en sus propias reseñas de Google.
parrafo_2.en: Weddings, receptions, company meetings and even private classes have all happened here: the space adapts to whatever event you bring, and the guests who have been here say so in their own Google reviews.

items.quote: Awesome place, lots of room for a decent size event

We had a great time at this creative and contemporary venue for our wedding reception. We couldn’t have asked for a better vendor in Chef Chriss and her team. From day one, they worked hard and graciously for us to have everything the way we wanted for our reception.

The painting class was great. I visited with a bunch of people with similar interests & we had fun. There was a lunch prepared & it was good. Later some were singing along with the music. It was a fun day to forget your troubles & enjoy being silly & let go for a bit! The location was good & parking was close.
